script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Being in the same prison does not establish that the officers had no separate cell.
The text does not say that nobody in the prison house was whistling. Joseph observes that the two officers are distraught.
The dream says birds were eating the baked goods, but it does not say the goods never reached Pharaoh.
The text does not say that the baked goods never get to Pharaoh.
The joke suggests that cookie boxes were part of Pharaoh's feast, a detail the text does not give.
The text does not say the cupbearer had just walked out of prison when he forgot Joseph.
Saying Joseph's request was never carried out goes beyond this passage. The cupbearer later tells Pharaoh about Joseph in Genesis 41:9-13.
